comparator.name: Human Resource Studies: People Management
comparator.sourceNotes: The official 2026–27 curriculum accounts for exactly 180 ECTS: 60 compulsory ECTS in year 1, 60 compulsory ECTS in year 2, and year 3 with a genuine 30-ECTS mobility window plus 30 compulsory ECTS, including comparative labour relations, social philosophy, cross-cultural HRM and a 12-ECTS thesis. Zero-credit GROW development is excluded, and no content is invented for the open mobility space.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest programme owns international and strategic people management, cross-cultural HRM, people analytics, evidence-based policy and the social-economic dimensions of work. Organisational psychology, well-being, talent and employee development form a coherent second route, while comparative labour relations and workforce governance form a distinct institutional route. Both exceed the 30-ECTS distinctness floor. Three alternatives is the maximum, and every generator-eligible interest has one construction owner.

notes.text: Tilburg prescribes a dedicated international People Management sequence with talent management, work-and-health psychology, analytics, evidence-based consulting, comparative European labour relations, cross-cultural HRM and a 12-ECTS thesis. UCR can construct coherent interdisciplinary routes in international people management, workplace psychology and labour institutions, but it does not reproduce the complete specialist HRM or methods sequence; the 30-ECTS mobility window remains open.
